risks: Our Company is highly dependent on a single supplier for a significant portion of its purchases, and any disruption in this relationship could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Our Company is highly dependent on a limited number of suppliers, including a single supplier, for a significant portion of its purchases.
We procure all of our products from third party supplier, and certain products are sourced from a limited number of suppliers or, in some cases, single supplier.
Any delays or disruptions or failure by our suppliers to supply materials in a timely manner could adversely affect our ability to deliver products to our customers.
Purchases from the top supplier were 73.96% in FY 2023–24, 71.39% in FY 2024-25 and 74.11% in FY 2025-26.

Our significant dependence on this single supplier exposes us to supplier concentration risk and any disruption, termination, non-renewal or material alteration of our commercial arrangements with the supplier could have a material adverse effect on our business operations.

Any adverse developments affecting the supplier, including changes in its business strategy, pricing policies, supply chain disruptions, regulatory actions, capacity constraints, financial condition or operational performance, could impact the availability, quality, pricing or timely supply of products to us.

Further, we may not be able to readily identify or transition to alternative suppliers on comparable commercial terms, quality standards or timelines, particularly for specialized or technologically advanced products.

_enrichment_conflicts.deterministic_value: PRODUCT PORTFOLIO Our company offers a wide range of products that are specifically designed to meet the diverse requirements of air conditioning and refrigeration industries.

Our Company was originally incorporated as a private limited company in the name of “FX Multitech Private Limited” under the provisions of the Companies Act, 1956 pursuant to a certificate of incorporation dated March 27, 2008, issued by Assistant Registrar of Companies, Gujarat, Dadra and Nagar Havelli. Thereafter, our Company was converted from a private limited company to a public limited company, pursuant to a resolution passed in the extraordinary general meeting of our Shareholders held on November 27, 2024, and consequently, the name of our Company was changed to FX Multitech Limited by deletion of the word ‘Private’. Our Company is engaged in the distribution and export of a diverse portfolio of products, primarily catering to the HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) and Industrial Refrigeration Industry.

internal_operational.risk: Our Company is highly dependent on a single supplier for a significant portion of its purchases, and any disruption in this relationship could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Our Company is highly dependent on a limited number of suppliers, including a single supplier, for a significant portion of its purchases.
We procure all of our products from third party supplier, and certain products are sourced from a limited number of suppliers or, in some cases, single supplier.
Any delays or disruptions or failure by our suppliers to supply materials in a timely manner could adversely affect our ability to deliver products to our customers.
Purchases from the top supplier were 73.96% in FY 2023–24, 71.39% in FY 2024-25 and 74.11% in FY 2025-26.

Our significant dependence on this single supplier exposes us to supplier concentration risk and any disruption, termination, non-renewal or material alteration of our commercial arrangements with the supplier could have a material adverse effect on our business operations.

strategy_growth.risk: We do not own any registered intellectual property rights, and any inability to protect or enforce our intellectual property may adversely affect our business.
As on date of this Red Herring Prospectus, neither our Company nor our Subsidiary owns any registered trademarks, copyrights or other intellectual property rights.
Our business relies, inter alia, on our trade name, brand identity and marketing materials, which may not be adequately protected in the absence of registered intellectual property rights.

There can be no assurance that third parties will not use, imitate or claim rights over similar names, marks or materials, or that such use will not result in disputes, infringement claims or dilution of our brand Further, in the absence of registered intellectual property rights, our ability to prevent unauthorized use or to enforce our rights against third parties may be limited, which could adversely affect our reputation, brand recognition and competitive position.

Our operations are dependent on third-party transportation and logistics service providers for the movement of products from our suppliers to our warehouses and from our warehouses to customers and export destinations, including ports.
We rely on our information technology systems in managing our supply chain, logistics and other integral parts of our business.
